title: Ruleset: new_game_scene
description: rules/<id>/new_game_scene.yaml: the new game's opening questions before the first map (apps/game: NewGameInterview): the line table, the partner each answer picks, the host, the camera, the fades and the naming box. Optional: without it a new game starts without the questions.

lines.description: The MAPHEAD section of the scene's line table (resolveMapHeadEntry).

partners.description: The Digimon id each answer picks, by the answer's number.

frame_ticks.description: Engine ticks per frame of the scene (its loop waits VSync(3)).

camera_projection.description: The original's projection distance over its 240-line screen (GsSetProjection), which gives the field of view.

camera_centre_line.description: The line of the original's 240 the projection is centred on (DRAWING_OFFSET_Y).

host.description: The Digimon that asks: its species, the clip it starts with, where it stands, the frame it turns on, the clip it plays then and its yaw before and after, in 4096ths of a turn.

position.description: Where it stands, in the original's axes (Y down).

sounds.description: The scene's and the naming box's sounds (playSound): the cursor, a confirm and a refused press.

naming.description: The naming box: the longest name, the grid's columns and its rows of letters (the first half is the left side, the second the right; a space is an empty cell).

full_delete_takes_two.description: The American version's delete: a full name loses two letters.

repeat_delay_frames.description: Frames a held movement key waits before it repeats.

repeat_frames.description: Frames between the repeats of a held movement key.

sound.description: A sound of the original's slots: slot and sound.
